$comment: Per-repo argus config: the invariants a model must respect, and what the answer has to look like.
The engine and the workflows live in DjodyKort/argus; this file and argus-rules.json are the parts
`enforcedBy` matters as much as `statement`. An invariant a test already proves does not need a model
turn spent re-deriving it; naming the gate keeps the model on the parts nothing mechanical covers.

invariants.statement: SURFACE_BIT values are persisted in asset.hiddenFrom. They must never be renumbered and a retired bit must never be reused, because either silently reinterprets every stored mask.
invariants.enforcedBy: server/src/utils/visibility-policy.spec.ts - the whole table is frozen by literal

invariants.statement: Surface.Trash has no bit, so a per-asset exclusion can never reach the trash view. Hiding a photo from the timeline must not make it unrecoverable.
invariants.enforcedBy: visibility-policy.spec.ts and the trash case in visibility-matrix.spec.ts

invariants.statement: Any endpoint that can return asset-bearing data is a surface and must be classified, or the visibility policy does not cover it. Neither a conflict nor a compile error reveals a new one.
invariants.enforcedBy: _fork/asset-surfaces.mjs, run by the asset-surfaces CI job

invariants.statement: asset_id_timeline_notDeleted_idx stays predicated on visibility = 'timeline', and 'timeline' stays a label of asset_visibility_enum. Losing either degrades every timeline query without failing a test.
Visibility rules live only in server/src/utils/visibility-policy.ts. No asset.visibility predicate is hand-written anywhere else; callers pick the helper that fits the shape.
invariants.enforcedBy: nothing mechanical, by choice - this one needs eyes

invariants.statement: Locked assets are kept out of shared links by the write path (Permission.AssetShare, which checks as forSharing() and is never elevated), because the shared-link read queries carry no visibility predicate at all. There is no second line of defence.

Mobile's mask uses its own local bit values, unrelated to the server's numbering, because sync carries surface names rather than integers. Coupling them would make the server's assignment unchangeable.
invariants.enforcedBy: nothing mechanical - mobile/lib/infrastructure/utils/visibility_policy.dart is the only place that knows mobile's mask

mustNot: weaken, skip or delete a test or gate to make it pass
state a verdict; report what to check and what you could not verify
claim a result you did not observe
hand-write an asset.visibility predicate instead of using a visibility-policy helper
renumber or reuse a SURFACE_BIT value
